scope: P3-A uniform scale and placement only; stop for human review
placementRule: B0 exact P2 transform. diagnosticLimits: 1m front clearance is an inspection target, not a navigation or building-code certification. Lower-surface grid and convex-obstacle vertex tests identify conflicts but cannot prove a watertight collision-free installation.
